item.title: About
item.description:
About

I hold an MBA from the University of Notre Dame and spent over a decade in finance, specializing in budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and executive reporting. After a period away from traditional employment to prioritize family stability, I continued building software independently and shipped two production systems.

My work sits at the intersection of systems thinking, business literacy, and software architecture. I design reliable, maintainable systems that solve real operational problems and scale in production.

item.title: Home
item.description:
Ashish K. Singh

Independent Python‑Focused Software Architect

I build production systems end‑to‑end: backend APIs, ML inference pipelines, and multi‑cloud SaaS platforms. My background combines an MBA from the University of Notre Dame and 11+ years in finance with hands‑on engineering across Python, ML, Kubernetes, and modern frontend stacks.

Selected projects

  • CoolChefy — multi‑cloud SaaS for intelligent meal planning and shopping automation.
  • ScreenGapResearch — ML inference pipeline for materials research deployed on Azure Containers and Queues.

Contact: domer03@gmail.com

item.title: Projects
item.description:
Projects

CoolChefy

Role: Architect, Full‑stack developer
Stack: Python (Django), Vue.js, TailwindCSS, Neon Postgres, Vercel/Render, Cloudflare
Summary: A multi‑cloud SaaS platform for meal planning and shopping list automation. Domain‑driven design, JWT auth, and a clean separation of frontend and backend services.

ScreenGapResearch

Role: Architect, ML pipeline engineer
Stack: FastAPI, Python ML stack, Azure Container Instances, Azure Storage Queues
Summary: Batch ML inference pipeline for materials research. CSV ingestion → queued jobs → containerized inference → secure result delivery.
